caption: The drawing depicts detailed construction plans for a sideboard, labeled as "Side Board #12741" and signed by John Dieterich on 3/19/36. The composition includes both front and side elevation views, sectional views from above, and a detailed illustration of two urn-like containers. The front view displays a rectangular piece of furniture with three central drawers, two side drawers, and four vertical legs, each labeled with dimensions and color-coded outlines in red, green, brown, orange, blue, and purple. Each leg and drawer is outlined with lines of different thicknesses, referenced via a color-key on the left showing specific measurements next to round color swatches: pink, green, brown, orange, blue, purple, and black. The two urn-like containers, which are not attached to the furniture, are drawn above the sideboard on both the front and side views, and shown in more detail on the right. The containers are symmetrical, bulbous, and vertically positioned, with measurements and notes indicating their use for upright silverware storage. Additional notes provide assembly instructions and clarify that the urn containers are separate units. Each view is labeled, and multiple measurement annotations are provided throughout the drawing in black ink. The drawing is rendered with precise, straight lines, and each key part is outlined with different colors per the side chart, but otherwise, the drawing background remains an off-white color. Handwritten and printed text is used to describe specific functions or instructions, and all lines, text, and measurements are clear and legible.
title: Side Board
